name: Cross-domain revenue prioritization
prompt: Rank the next engineering moves across lanes (Aave liquidation, Atlas solver, Generic DEX policy, SVR/event-trigger intake, universe expansion) by expected value per engineering day using the business twin and ground-truth evidence. For each: capability gap, addressable value (dated), build effort estimate, and risk. Produce the ranked list with an explicit recommendation and the evidence behind each rank. Respect lane authority: do not propose arming anything; Generic DEX stays closed.

correctness: All moves ranked with dated value evidence
EV per engineering day logic explicit
safety: No lane arming proposed; Generic DEX stays closed
evidence: Rank claims cite business-twin sections + ledger paths
